items.t: Air suspension (Airmatic) sagging overnight
items.job: Replace one leaking Airmatic air strut
items.note: Price is for one corner with a quality aftermarket strut at the low end and a genuine part at the high end. Leak testing first avoids replacing good struts.

items.t: Air suspension compressor running constantly or burned out
items.job: Replace Airmatic compressor and relay
items.note: Aftermarket compressors for older cars are much cheaper than dealer parts. Fix any air leak at the same time.

items.t: Active Body Control (ABC) hydraulic leak or pump failure
items.job: Repair ABC leak (hose, accumulator or strut) or replace ABC pump
items.note: A single hose or accumulator is at the low end; a pump or several struts can run well past the high end.

items.t: ABC suspension high-pressure hose can corrode and leak (recall)
items.job: Replace ABC high-pressure hose under recall

items.t: Rust on body panels and subframe
items.job: Body rust repair or subframe rust treatment
items.note: Small spots cost far less; structural subframe work is at the top of the range.

items.t: Power windows or door locks stop working
items.job: Replace window regulator/motor or door lock actuator
items.note: A door control module costs more and may need coding with a dealer-level scan tool.

items.t: Central locking, trunk and seat functions fail (vacuum pump)
items.job: Replace PSE vacuum/pressure pump or repair leaking hose
items.note: A cracked hose is cheap; a new pump is the high end. Used pumps are common for this older car.

items.t: Broken coil spring or worn subframe bushings
items.job: Replace coil springs (pair) or subframe bushings
items.note: Subframe bushings take longer than springs.

items.t: Engine wiring harness insulation crumbling
items.job: Replace engine wiring harness
items.note: The electric throttle actuator often has the same wiring problem and may need repair too.

items.t: Plastic camshaft oil tubes break
items.job: Replace cam oiler tubes with metal versions
items.note: Valve covers come off, so new valve cover gaskets are usually added.

items.t: Transmission fluid leak at the electrical plug
items.job: Replace transmission connector adapter and seals, top up fluid

items.t: Sluggish shifts or torque converter shudder
items.job: Transmission fluid and filter service (torque converter if needed)
items.note: A fluid service is the low end; a torque converter replacement is the high end.

items.t: Crankshaft position sensor failure
items.job: Replace crankshaft position sensor

items.t: Water leaking into cabin or trunk
items.job: Clear sunroof drains and reseal taillights
items.note: Drying carpets or replacing water-damaged modules costs extra.

items.t: Blower motor regulator can overheat (recall)
items.job: Replace blower motor regulator under recall

items.t: V12 misfire from ignition coils or spark plugs
items.job: Replace V12 spark plugs and failed coil packs
items.note: 24 spark plugs; each coil pack fires six cylinders and is expensive.

items.t: Worn timing idler gear (5.5L V8)
items.job: Replace timing idler gear, chain and related parts
items.note: Reported totals run $5,000 to $10,000 or more if cylinder heads are damaged.

items.t: Transmission stuck in limp mode (conductor plate or control unit)
items.job: Replace conductor plate or transmission control unit and code it
items.note: Specialists can repair or reprogram used control units for less.

items.t: Climate blower motor stops working
items.job: Replace blower motor
items.note: Dealer quotes run about $650 to $900 total.

items.t: Hybrid inverter failure leaves car unable to start
items.job: Replace hybrid inverter/converter assembly

items.t: Timing chain rattle on cold start (twin-turbo V8)
items.job: Replace timing chain tensioners (chains, guides and sprockets if stretched)
items.note: Tensioners alone are at the low end; a full chain set is at the high end.

items.t: Valve cover oil leak and burning oil smell
items.job: Replace both valve covers and gaskets

items.t: Harsh or clunky gear changes
items.job: Transmission fluid and filter service with adaptation reset (conductor plate if needed)

items.t: Battery goes flat after the car sits
items.job: Parasitic drain test and battery or module replacement

items.t: Engine oil plugs may leak under high load (recall)
items.job: Install retaining plate on engine oil plugs under recall

items.t: Drive shaft joint can break (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace drive shaft under recall

items.t: Emergency call (eCall) may not work (recall)
items.job: Communication module software update under recall

items.t: Engine may stall or overheat from Camtronic fault (recall)
items.job: Engine control unit software update under recall

items.t: Fuel pump can fail and stall the engine (recall)
items.job: Fuel pump repair under recall

items.t: Front brake hoses can rupture (recall)
items.job: Replace front brake hoses under recall

items.t: High-voltage starter generator unit can fail (recall)
items.job: Control unit software update under recall
